title: P/E ratio: how to tell if a stock is cheap or expensive
short: P/E ratio: how to tell if a stock is cheap or expensive
dek: The most quoted number in investing, explained with simple maths: what it measures, why some companies trade at 80 times profit, and where it misleads.
card: What the price-to-earnings ratio really measures, and the three ways it can fool you.
